select * from (SELECT (select pcc.subject_change_id from PRJ_CHECK_SUBJECT_CHANGE pcc where pcc.CHECK_ID = #{checkId}) subject_change_id, (select pcc.remark from PRJ_CHECK_SUBJECT_CHANGE pcc where pcc.CHECK_ID = #{checkId}) remark, p.check_id, c.project_id, c.tenant_id bp_id,
CASE WHEN c.BUSINESS_TYPE in('T+N_LEASE_FACTORING','T+0_LEASE_FACTORING') THEN ( SELECT wm_concat(b.bp_name) FROM hls_bp_master b ,prj_project_bp hclcb WHERE c.PROJECT_ID = hclcb.PROJECT_ID and b.bp_id = hclcb.bp_id and hclcb.bp_type = 'RECEIVABLE_DEBTOR' ) WHEN c.BUSINESS_TYPE in('LEASE_WITHOUT_RECOURSE_IN','OPERATING_LEASE_WITHOUT_RECOURSE_IN') THEN ( SELECT wm_concat(b.bp_name) FROM hls_bp_master b ,prj_project_bp hclcb WHERE c.PROJECT_ID = hclcb.PROJECT_ID and b.bp_id = hclcb.bp_id and hclcb.bp_type = 'ASSET_TRANSFEROR' ) ELSE ( SELECT wm_concat(b.bp_name) FROM hls_bp_master b ,prj_project_bp hclcb WHERE c.PROJECT_ID = hclcb.PROJECT_ID and b.bp_id = hclcb.bp_id and hclcb.bp_type = 'TENANT' ) END AS bp_name,
c.contract_number,
(SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM prj_project_bp t1, hls_bp_master hbm WHERE t1.bp_id = hbm.BP_ID AND t1.project_id=c.project_id and t1.bp_type = 'WARRANTOR' and rownum=1 ) GUARANTOR, p.check_number FROM prj_check p, prj_project c WHERE p.contract_id = c.project_id) t
1=1
and t.CHECK_ID = #{checkId}
and t.contract_number = #{contractNumber}

select pcsc.subject_change_id, pcsc.check_id, pcsc.contract_number, pcsc.bp_name, gua_bp.bp_name as guarantor, pcsc.remark, pp.project_id from prj_check_subject_change pcsc left join prj_check pc on pcsc.check_id = pc.check_id left join prj_project pp on pc.contract_id = pp.project_id left join (select ppb.project_id,wm_concat(hbm.bp_name) as bp_name from prj_project_bp ppb ,hls_bp_master hbm where ppb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id and ppb.bp_type = 'WARRANTOR' group by ppb.project_id) gua_bp on gua_bp.project_id = pp.project_id
1=1 and pcsc.CHECK_ID = #{checkId}
